The structure of Al22Co4Ge2 (reduced formula Al11Co2Ge) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for Al, Co, and Ge centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors; Al environments involve Al, Co, and Ge neighbors, while Co and Ge centers are coordinated by 10 Al plus 2 of the other element. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 28 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows 12-vertex Al polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces in selected observed patterns.
